mechanism: The call argument of a &T parameter is an implicit reborrow &*global; MIR ReferencePropagation rewrites it to &((*box).0) when global is an SSA &PLACE, so the +8 GEP is recomputed in the call block. Making global opaque at RefProp time (a #[cold] helper call, which the MIR inliner refuses but LLVM inlines; or an unannotated tuple-field copy) keeps the GEP in the over-reserves block. InstCombine cannot sink it (the call block's unique predecessor is the memcmp block), and MachineSink places the add at the top of the call block, as in the original.
